column11: 哟，瞧瞧，\n这是谁在这儿呢……
这么多好吃的，\n见者有份，对吧？？

column10: Not only munchies\nbut a little babe,
column11: 不光有点心，\n还有个漂亮小妞，

column10: all dressed up for us,\nain't that right??
column11: 特意为哥几个打扮的，\n是不是啊？？

column10: How about if you and I go\nfor a little walk outside, huh?
column11: 要不你跟哥哥我\n去外面散个小步，哈？

column10: Let the punks stay\nand eat their food!
column11: 让那群软蛋留在这儿\n吃他们的剩饭去吧！

column10: There is no need to fear!!

column11: 因为本大爷乔伊·陈闪亮登场！！

column10: I have travelled the Seven Seas,
I have crossed every mountain\nknown to man,
column11: 征服过人类已知的每一座崇山，

column10: and I know that the mighty powers\nthat I have
column11: 我深知自己拥有的神圣力量，

column10: are enough for jerks like you.
column11: 收拾你们这帮无赖绰绰有余。

column10: and shall take you on a cruise\nto destroy all of you.
column11: 带你们来一场彻底毁灭的巡航。

column10: Now, let me tell you of this one\nincident at this coffee shop......
column11: 现在，让我给你们讲讲\n那次在咖啡馆里发生的事……
